hooks.name: Post-Experiment Data Sync
hooks.description: Runs post_experiment_sync after agent stops to keep all data stores (dashboard, eval report, coverage, ResultIndex) coherent. Also fixes GT↔NPZ e_exact drift automatically.

action.command: .venv/bin/python -c "from qmbp_simulation.analysis.metrics import validate_gt_npz_coherence, post_experiment_sync; validate_gt_npz_coherence(fix=True); post_experiment_sync(verbose=False)"
